#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
ll M;

ll powmod(ll a, ll b) {
    ll r = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) r = r * a % M;
        a = a * a % M;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}
ll inv(ll a) {
    return powmod(a, M - 2);
}
ll f(ll c, ll p) {
    if (p == 0) return 1;
    return powmod(c + 1, p - 1) * (c + 1 - p) % M;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
    ll c, p;
    cin >> c >> p >> M;
    vector<vector<ll>> newt(c + 3, vector<ll>(c + 3, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; ++i) {
        newt[i][0] = newt[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
            newt[i][j] = (newt[i - 1][j] + newt[i - 1][j - 1]) % M;
        }
    }
    ll ans = f(c, p);
    ans = ans * powmod(2, p) % M;
    ll sum_e = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= p; ++i) {
        ll e = 0;
        for (int w = 1; w <= i - 1; ++w) {
            ll zioms = newt[i - 1][w] % M;
            zioms = zioms * f(w, w) % M;
            zioms = zioms * f(c - w - 1, i - 1 - w) % M;
            zioms = zioms * inv(powmod(c + 1, i - 1)) % M;
            e = (e + w * (w + 1) / 2 * zioms) % M;
        }
        sum_e = (sum_e + e) % M;
    }
    cout << ans * sum_e % M << '\n';
    return 0;
}

ll MOD;

    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}
ll minv(ll a) { return mpow(a, MOD - 2); }

ll calc(ll c, ll p) {
    vector<vector<ll>> binom(c + 3, vector<ll>(c + 3));
    for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; ++i) {
        binom[i][0] = binom[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j)
            binom[i][j] = (binom[i - 1][j] + binom[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD;

    vector<ll> invPowC(p + 2);
    for (int i = 0; i <= p; ++i) invPowC[i] = minv(powC[i]);

    vector<ll> pow2(p + 1);
    pow2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= p; ++i) pow2[i] = pow2[i - 1] * 2 % MOD;

    auto F = [&](ll cc, ll pp) {
        if (pp == 0) return 1LL;
        return mpow(cc + 1, pp - 1) * (cc + 1 - pp) % MOD;

    ll ans = F(c, p) * pow2[p] % MOD;
    ll sumE = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= p; ++i) {

        ll invPow = invPowC[i - 1];

            t = t * F(c - w - 1, i - 1 - w) % MOD;
            t = t * invPow % MOD;
            e = (e + (w * (w + 1) / 2) * t) % MOD;
        }
        sumE = (sumE + e) % MOD;
    }
    return ans * sumE % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
    ll c, p;
    cin >> c >> p >> MOD;
    cout << calc(c, p) << '\n';
